REBW.description: Rebar Input for Wall Section (REBW). The key is the Wall element ID (1..9999); ITEMS holds one or more rebar entries whose applicable fields depend on CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID, USE_END_REBAR and USE_MODEL_THICKNESS flags.

ITEMS.description: Wall rebar entries. Each item defines vertical/horizontal (and optional end / boundary-element) rebar for the wall keyed by Wall ID.

CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID.description: When true, this item targets a sub-wall spanning a story range; STORY becomes required and the entry is stored under a sub-wall (story) sub-key. When false the entry applies to the whole wall.

SUB_WALL_ID.description: [CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID=true] Sub-wall (story) sub-key to target. If omitted (or <=0) the first story in the resolved range is used. Ignored when CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID=false.

STORY.description: [CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID=true] Story range (by story name) the sub-wall spans; required when CREATE_SUB_WALL_ID=true. FROM/TO story names are resolved to story keys and the full level range between them is expanded.

FROM.description: Start story name of the range.

TO.description: End story name of the range.

VERTICAL_REBAR.description: Vertical rebar (NAME + spacing). Rebar NAME is validated against the model rebar material DB; DIST must be > 0.

NAME.description: Rebar size name (e.g. D10..D57); must be a valid rebar kind registered in the model material DB.

DIST.description: Rebar spacing; must be positive. Supports non-SI unit conversion.

HORIZONTAL_REBAR.description: Horizontal rebar (NAME + spacing). Rebar NAME is validated against the model rebar material DB; DIST must be > 0.

NAME.description: Rebar size name; must be a valid rebar kind registered in the model material DB.

DIST.description: Rebar spacing; must be positive. Supports non-SI unit conversion.

USE_END_REBAR.description: When true, END_REBAR becomes required and end (edge) rebar is applied.

END_REBAR.description: [USE_END_REBAR=true] End (edge) rebar; required when USE_END_REBAR=true. NUM must be an even integer >= 2 and DIST must be > 0.

NAME.description: End rebar size name; must be a valid rebar kind registered in the model material DB.

NUM.description: Number of end rebars; must be an even number >= 2 (odd values or values < 2 are rejected).

DIST.description: End rebar spacing; must be positive. Supports non-SI unit conversion.

BE_HORIZONTAL_REBAR.description: Boundary-element horizontal rebar (optional). When provided, NAME is validated against the rebar material DB and DIST must be > 0.

NAME.description: Boundary-element horizontal rebar size name; must be a valid rebar kind registered in the model material DB.

DIST.description: Rebar spacing; must be positive. Supports non-SI unit conversion.

CONCRETE_FACE_TO_CENTER_OF_REBAR.description: Concrete face to rebar center distances (dw for vertical rebar, de for boundary-element rebar). Both must be >= 0.

DW.description: Concrete face to center of vertical rebar (dw); must be >= 0.

DE.description: Concrete face to center of boundary-element rebar (de); must be >= 0.

USE_MODEL_THICKNESS.description: When true, the wall's model thickness is used. When false, THICKNESS becomes required and must be > 0.

THICKNESS.description: [USE_MODEL_THICKNESS=false] Wall thickness override; required and must be positive when USE_MODEL_THICKNESS=false.
